capture.setupIntro: This drone captures pose-tagged keyframes as it flies. A paired compute node reconstructs them into a 3D world model you can view here.
capture.howStep1Body: The drone's cameras record keyframes with pose as it flies. No reconstruction runs on the drone.
capture.howStep2Body: A paired compute or workstation node builds the splat, point cloud, or mesh from the keyframes.
capture.howStep3Body: The finished world model appears here, and updates live in the Live World view while capturing.

droneAccess.intro: Each paired drone and ground station needs a credential from this workstation before it can stream capture, offload perception or fetch artifacts here. It is provisioned automatically.

agent.computeLanNote: Serves the fleet on your LAN · pairing-gated

atlas.title: World model setup
atlas.blurb: Capture pose-tagged keyframes as this drone flies; a paired compute node reconstructs a 3D world model.
atlas.featureHint: Master switch. Reveals the World Model tabs and enables the native capture service on the node.
atlas.poseTierHint: Where the capture pose is estimated. Auto picks by board capability; on-board uses local VIO; offloaded runs on a paired compute node.
atlas.captureManagedHint: Capture profile and reconstruction detail are managed on the World Model tab, next to the capture controls.

perception.title: Perception setup
perception.blurb: What this node detects and where perception runs — on its own accelerator, or offloaded to a serving workstation.

offload.blurb: When this drone has no local accelerator, it streams frames to a serving workstation that runs the detector and returns the results.
offload.activeHint: The workstation the agent is offloading to right now.
offload.enabledHint: Auto offloads only when this node has no local accelerator. On always offloads; Off keeps perception on-node.
offload.pinHint: Pin a specific serving workstation, or leave on Auto to use any on the LAN.
offload.pinNoWorkstation: No paired workstation. Pair a workstation node to pin it here.
offload.pinNoAddress: No paired workstation has a LAN address. Connect to one over the LAN to pin it here.

serving.blurb: This workstation runs the detector for drones that offload perception to it.
serving.enabledHint: Auto serves when a drone requests it. On advertises this node as available; Off declines offload requests.
serving.modelHint: The model this workstation runs for offloaded detection. Leave on default to let the node choose.

perception.unsupportedProfile: Perception offload applies to drone, workstation and compute nodes.

worldEngine.unknownPage: This World Engine page ({id}) is not part of this version.
